card.name: Words just before clinical-study findings
card.fires_on: The word right after a study or trial description where the text is about to report findings, such as "showed" after pooled analyses, or "-term" in "long-term" effects or usefulness.

modes.label: Pooled analyses showed
modes.description: The verb "showed" after a description of pooled placebo-controlled trials, before the result is stated.

modes.label: Long-term
modes.description: The "-term" in "long-term" before effects or usefulness of a treatment.
modes.example: These studies monitor long<<-term>> side effects after the treatment has been marketed

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like clinical and clinically, and away from trial and trials, in the next position.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug label where trial results or long-term findings are about to be described.
